posts.cooked:
Is there a way to create macros from the official character sheet?

I see in the image that is given as an example that they have a “power suit” and the dice to roll for that ability on the top left. Is there a way to create that?

The community sheet has a way to put a check next to each ability, but I didn’t see a way to pull the powers from a database like the official sheet does. It would be rather cumbersome to type in all the abilities for each character.

Thanks for the help and any other tips for running a game on Roll20.
